articles.title: RPF Pune Division Registers 920 Cases In Rail Safety Enforcement Campaign

articles.title: Improving Road Safety Around Rail Stations Is Critical for Urban Mobility
articles.description: A new World Bank-backed guide highlights that while urban rail systems are generally safe, the areas around railway stations and crossings often pose serious risks for pedestrians, cyclists, and other road users. It urges cities to integrate road safety planning, better infrastructure, and coordinated policies to make station access safer and public transport more reliable.

articles.title: Trailblazing Journey: Women-Led Rail Crew on Women's Day
articles.description: An all-women crew operated a passenger train from Ranchi to Irgaon on International Women's Day. The initiative demonstrated women's growing presence in traditionally male-dominated fields like railways. The train, managed entirely by women, showcased the increasing acceptance and encouragement of women in various sectors, emphasizing safety and success.
